title: Print a whole number
instruction: Print the number **42** using `print()`. Do NOT use quotes around the number.

title: Print a decimal number
instruction: Print the decimal number **3.14** using `print()`. No quotes needed.

title: Print your age as a number
instruction: Print your **age** as a number (without quotes). You can use any age you like.
starter_code: # Print your age as a number

title: Print two numbers on one line
instruction: Print two numbers — **100** and **200** — on the same line using a single `print()` with a comma between them.
starter_code: # Print 100 and 200 on the same line

title: Mix a string and a number
instruction: Print the string **My lucky number is** followed by the number **7** (no quotes on the number) — both in one `print()`, separated by a comma.
